name: Negators
description: Phyrexian soldiers that massacre the Tolarian students and teachers.

timeline.summary: Jhoira hides the shipwrecked Kerrick; Karn sees him steal powerstones and call for Negators, who massacre the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi and Barrin.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian Negators massacred most of the students and teachers including Jhoira, Teferi, and Barrin.
